Katherine — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- Need: low-latency inference for real-time fraud scoring (1–3s P95), with on-prem option for EU data.
- Success metrics: 99.5% uptime during business hours, <3s P95, cost target ~30% below current provider.
- Action items from our side: share draft SOW + preliminary sizing and pricing (attached: Redwood_SOW_v0.3.pdf).
- Action items on your side: procurement/counsel to review and confirm any data-processing constraints + proposed contract changes.

Can you confirm who on your legal/procurement side will own the redlines, and an estimated preferred timeline for review? We wanted to check whether this is still a priority for the team over the next 2–3 weeks so we can reserve engineering ramp time.

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can prepare a short appendix on data handling/kv-cache pruning for counsel.

Thanks — talk soon.
